task.description: Step 3 implementation: migrate CapabilitySet.summary() from Zig 0.15 managed ArrayList to Zig 0.16 unmanaged API per design S1-S5. Add ISS-0174 test block to src/lua_test_root.zig covering TC-CS-01..05. Run deliberate-mutation verification per design section 6.
acceptance_criteria: MUST-1: src/lua/capabilities.zig compiles under Zig 0.16 with body genuinely analysed
MUST-2: std.ArrayList(u8).init(allocator) migrated to unmanaged API (.empty + allocator-passing appendSlice/toOwnedSlice/deinit)
MUST-3: A build target CALLS CapabilitySet.summary() and asserts on output (TC-CS-01..05)
MUST-4: Deliberate-mutation verification: inject statement error -> zig build test-lua goes red
MUST-5: Decision recorded on whether summary() should exist at all (RETAIN)

result.summary: Migrated CapabilitySet.summary() to Zig 0.16 unmanaged ArrayList per design S1-S5 (lines 49-60 of src/lua/capabilities.zig): std.ArrayList(u8).init -> .empty; defer buf.deinit() -> defer buf.deinit(allocator); appendSlice -> appendSlice(allocator, ...); toOwnedSlice -> toOwnedSlice(allocator). Sorted grant keys lexicographically before joining so TC-CS-03 is deterministic. Added longjmp-unsafe (ERR-2) doc comment mirroring writeGrants. New test block 'ISS-0174 / GH-502: CapabilitySet.summary() compiles, runs, and renders both branches' added to src/lua_test_root.zig covering TC-CS-01..05. Deliberate mutation (u32 := string) on line 55 made zig build test-lua go RED with a type error citing the new test block; mutation reverted, build is GREEN.

MUST-1.evidence: zig build exits 0; deliberate mutation makes build go RED with type error citing capabilities.zig:55:27 — proves body is genuinely analysed.

MUST-2.evidence: All 5 substitutions (S1-S5) applied to live source by token. Verified by direct read of src/lua/capabilities.zig lines 49-83.

MUST-3.evidence: zig build test-lua: 72/72 tests passed (was 71/71, +1 from new ISS-0174 block). New block exercises summary() for real across empty + single + multi-grant branches.

MUST-4.evidence: Mutation: const _bad: u32 = 'definitely not a u32'; in summary() body -> zig build test-lua exit 1 with: src\lua\capabilities.zig:55:27: error: expected type 'u32', found '*const [20:0]u8' AND 'test.ISS-0174 / GH-502: ...: src\lua_test_root.zig:311:39'. Reverted -> exit 0, 72/72 passed. Logged in scratch/_iss0174_mutation_red.log and scratch/_iss0174_after_revert.log.

MUST-5.evidence: Decision: RETAIN. Recorded in: (a) diagnosis YAML fix_plan.decision (RETAIN), (b) design header 'decision: RETAIN', (c) summary() doc comment (longjmp-unsafe contract), (d) this handoff context.decision field.

validation_outputs.zig_build_test: exit 0; 945/1009 tests passed (64 pre-existing skipped, not from this change)
validation_outputs.lint_test_isolation: exit 0; OK — 131 file(s) checked, no isolation issues

deviations: TC-CS-02 length assertion was 20 not 21 — corrected during implementation (the literal 'service:call:payment' is 20 chars, not 21). Documented in commit message.

Added a small helper `lessThanStr(_: void, lhs, rhs)` as the comparator for std.mem.sort. Required because std.mem.sort's context parameter cannot be a closure in Zig; the design did not explicitly forbid it but also did not require it. Keeping it private (file-scope, lowercase, not exported) preserves the public surface.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGNER (Step 4) for test design validation. The new test block is already in place; TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR should run lint_test_isolation.py and lint_handoffs.py, then check (1) every MUST requirement has a runnable integration test (the ISS-0174 block IS the test — it lives in src/lua_test_root.zig and is reached by zig build test-lua), (2) no error.SkipZigTest on MUST tests (none here — all in-test assertions are std.testing.expectEqual/expectEqualStrings), (3) all fixtures use per-test UUIDs (no fixture-state across tests; each block constructs its own CapabilitySet), (4) tests clean up after themselves (defer caps.deinit + defer gpa.free(slice) in every sub-case), (5) tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL is absent (this is a unit test — no DB dependency).
